number.title: number of tabs before triggering discard

max.single.discard.title: maximum number of tabs to discard per single discarding request

audio.title: true => do not discard if audio is playing

paused.title: true => do not discard if there is a paused media player

pinned.title: true => do not discard if tab is pinned

split-view.title: true => do not discard split tabs if either tab of the split is focused

form.title: true => do not discard if form data is changed

battery.title: true => only discard if power is disconnected

online.title: true => do not discard if there is no INTERNET connection

idle.title: true => only discard while the system is idle

go-hidden.title: Discard a tab if it is hidden

memory-enabled.title: Discard a background tab based on its memory usage (totalJSHeapSize)

memory-value.title: Discard a background tab if its memory usage (totalJSHeapSize) exceeds (in MB)

simultaneous-jobs.title: Number of allowed simultaneous discarding jobs

favicon.title: Change favicon of discarded tabs (if possible)

prepends.title: Prepend a symbol to the title of discarded tabs

page.context.title: Display discarding items in the "page" context menu

tab.context.title: Display discarding items in the "tab" context menu (if supported)

link.context.title: Display "Open Link in New Discarded Tab" item in the "link" context menu

click.title: The action of clicking on the toolbar button (which item on the menu to perform)

discard-protected-on-close.title: Discard pinned or grouped tabs instead of closing them

whitelist.title: List of domains or regular expression rules whose tabs are never discarded

whitelist-url.title: List of domains or regular expression rules of the tabs that are only discarded

force.hostnames.title: List of domains to discard immediately after their tabs become inactive

trash.period.title: Trash discarded tabs after about x hours if the trash plug-in is enabled

trash.unloaded.title: Include never-loaded tabs in the trash process

trash.whitelist-url.title: List of domains or regular expression rules with their own closing interval

startup-unpinned.title: Discard unpinned tabs on a browser restart

startup-pinned.title: Discard pinned tabs on a browser restart

startup-release-pinned.title: Release discarding state of pinned tabs on a browser restart
